label: Battery DP Shadow
info:
Shadow planner: cost-optimal dynamic programming beside the live optimizer. **Controls nothing.**

Every slot (cron :00:45/:15:45/:30:45/:45:45, after the live optimizer has written `global.pp.prediction`):
1. books the slot that just ended for a *virtual* battery that followed only the shadow's own commands (measured PV + load, 0.887/0.915, 30 kWh, 3% cutoff), and the real house at the measured grid flow;
2. plans the current slot by DP over the live optimizer's own forecasts, starting from the virtual SOC. Objective: grid cost first, wear (1.5 ct/kWh out of the cells) second, nothing else.

State: flow context `dpShadow` (file store). Log: `infra_2y.dpshadow`, one point per settled slot (sh_* = shadow, live_* = real house). Plan: `forecast.batteryplan` fields `dpState`, `dpPredictedSoc` (Grafana Forecast / Forecast2day).
Compare: `SELECT sum(sh_cost), sum(live_cost), last(sh_soc), last(real_soc), sum(sh_dcout), sum(live_dcout) FROM dpshadow WHERE time > now() - 7d` (cost in ct; value the SOC gap at ~18 ct/kWh).
`reset shadow` re-seeds the virtual SOC from the real BMS SOC and clears the totals.

Replay 2026-09-01..28 / 09-20..10-15 (cost + wear, SOC-adjusted): live -8.74 / -5.64 EUR, this planner -17.18 / -7.12 EUR; lowest SOC 16% vs 3%.
Source: `dp_shadow_func.js` in the repo.

name: === Changelog ===
info:
### 2026-10-17b
- The shadow's whole plan goes to forecast.batteryplan as fields dpState / dpPredictedSoc (beside the live state / predictedSoc), shown on the Grafana Forecast and Forecast2day dashboards. dpPredictedSoc starts from the virtual battery's SOC.

### 2026-10-17
- New tab: DP shadow planner (see the tab info). Replay vs live: +8.4 EUR (Sep 1-28) and +1.5 EUR (Sep 20-Oct 15), cost + wear.
